high-nest.title: High Nest
howto: A plank swings above your treehouse. Tap to drop it.
Only the part that lands on the stack stays; the overhang is sawn off.
Miss the stack completely and the build is over. Stack as high as you can.
tips: Watch the plank's edges, not the owl: tap when they line up with the plank below.
Four PERFECT drops in a row make your plank 18 px wider.
The swing speeds up with every plank, so the first ten are the time to bank PERFECTs.
The dotted rust line in the sky marks your best height.

controls.keyboard: Space or Enter drops the plank (and starts a build). P or Esc pauses. M switches the game's sound.
controls.touch: Tap anywhere to drop the plank. The pause tab is top right.

cheats.effect: Planks swing in twice as wide
Wood glue: every drop that touches the stack lands PERFECT

high-nest.difficulty: Pick the saw speed on the title card: Easy starts slow, never passes a medium swing and forgives 10 px on a PERFECT; Normal is the classic curve; Hard starts fast and only forgives 5 px. The swing speeds up with every plank, and each setting keeps its own best.

features.one-tap-start: Start building on the title card, or Space or Enter; the saw speed tabs sit under it
features.instant-restart: Build another on the results card (or Space), and Restart in the pause menu
features.best-score-badge: BEST in the top-left scoreboard, plus a dotted BEST line across the sky at your record height
features.tutorial-card: First play: a foreman's note with a swinging-plank animation says Tap to drop and slows the first plank; it praises the first drop and can be skipped or replayed from How to play
features.results: Results card with planks, height, perfects, best combo and the best for this saw speed, plus NEW BEST

market-merge.title: Market Merge
howto: Aim the fruit above the crate and drop it in.
Two of the same fruit that touch squash into the next size up; quick chains score extra.
Keep everything below the dashed rim: fruit resting above it for a moment closes the stall.
tips: Keep the big fruit in one corner and feed the small ones in beside them.
Check NEXT before you drop so you know where the following fruit will go.
Two watermelons that meet are sold for +200.
Undo takes back your last drop: Easy gives 5 per crate, Normal 3 and Hard 1.

controls.keyboard: Mouse or arrow keys aim; click, Space or Enter drops. U undoes, H shows a hint, P or Esc pauses, M switches the game's sound.
controls.touch: Touch the crate and drag to aim, lift your finger to drop. Undo and Hint sit bottom left; the pause tab is top right.

cheats.effect: Slow-motion crate: fruit falls and rolls at half speed
The fruit in your hand becomes a pumpkin

market-merge.difficulty: Stall rules on the title card: Easy only drops cherries to apricots, gives 5 undos and a longer grace at the rim; Normal drops up to oranges with 3 undos; Hard drops up to apples with 1 undo and a short grace. Each keeps its own best. The daily crate plays Normal rules.

features.hints: Hint button (bottom left), H, or Hint in the pause menu: rings the open fruit of the same kind to drop onto, or the lowest free spot, and says why
features.undo: Undo button (bottom left) or U takes back the last drop, score and supplier order included; Easy 5, Normal 3, Hard 1 per crate
features.level-select-or-daily: Daily crate on the title card: the same seeded fruit order for everyone today, with its own best
features.results: Overflow card with score, best for the rules played, fruits merged, biggest fruit and best chain, plus NEW BEST
features.tutorial: First crate: three coach notes teach aim, drop and merge by doing each one (the first two fruits are cherries); skippable, and replayed from How to play

hole-grind.title: Hole Grind
hole-grind.why3d: Hole.io is a 3D game: the fun is watching buildings tip into the hole.
howto: Steer the hole around the city and swallow anything smaller than it.
Every bite makes the hole wider, so cones, benches, trees, cars, buses and houses become food in turn.
A rival hole that grows bigger than you swallows you. When the clock runs out your score is banked as coins for upgrades and new districts.
tips: Watch NEXT in the top-left panel: it says how big you must be to swallow the next kind of prop.
Early on, sweep up coins and cones; they add up fast.
GRAVITY WELL drags nearby food into you, a strong first buy.
Beat a district's quota to clear it; later districts pay up to x3.20 per bite.

controls.keyboard: WASD or the arrow keys steer, or hold the mouse button and the hole rolls toward the pointer. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Hold a finger on the screen and the hole rolls toward it. The pause button is top right.

cheats.effect: Start every run three times as wide

hole-grind.difficulty: Each district is a harder band: more rival holes (1 in Suburb up to 5 in The Void) and a bigger quota. Rivals are sized from your own mass, so they keep pace as you grow: harmless in Suburb, hunters by Skyline. A wave of bigger props lands every 12 seconds, and coin upgrades make later runs easier.

features.one-tap-start: DROP IN on the hub starts a run in the chosen district
features.instant-restart: RUN AGAIN on the results card, and Restart in the pause menu
features.best-score-badge: BEST RUN tile in the hub, and a ★ BEST mark on the results score
features.tutorial-card: First run: an animated STEER THE HOLE card; the clock waits until you have swallowed 3 things, then a GROW card follows. Skippable, and replayed from How to play
features.results: TIME UP or SWALLOWED card with score, coins, XP, props swallowed, final size and quota progress

settings.quality: Hub > GRAPHICS: HIGH / LOW (Low draws at 1x resolution, drops prop shadows and thins the particles)

balloon-bust.title: Balloon Bust
howto: Pick Math Pop (sums within 20) or Word Pop (first words), and a speed. Tapping the sky starts the highlighted (pink) mode.
The blimp asks a question and answer balloons float up. Tap the balloon with the answer.
Right pops earn stars; a wrong pop just shows a hint. Every 10 stars become a sticker in your sticker book.
tips: Three right pops in a row double your stars, and the combo climbs up to x4.
Missed one? The hint card shows how to count it, or which letter the word starts with.
Balloons that float away come back from the bottom, so take your time.
Chill speed gives little hands more time to aim.

controls.keyboard: Click a balloon, or press 1 to 4 to pop the balloons counted from the left. On the title, 1 picks Math Pop, 2 Word Pop, Enter plays. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap Math Pop or Word Pop (or anywhere on the sky) to start, then tap a balloon. The pause button is top right.

cheats.effect: Party mode: rainbow confetti on every pop
Balloons float up at half speed

balloon-bust.difficulty: Pick Chill, Normal or Zoom on the title to set how fast the balloons rise. Sums stay within 20 and the words are first-grade words, made for ages 4 to 8. Nothing ever ends a round early.

features.one-tap-start: Tap Math Pop or Word Pop, or tap anywhere on the sky to play the highlighted mode (keys: 1, 2 or Enter)
features.instant-restart: Play again on the results card, Enter, or Restart in the pause menu
features.best-score-badge: Stars and streak top left while you play; the title shows the sticker book and your best streak
features.tutorial-card: First round: a Tap the balloon with the answer card, a bouncing arrow over the right balloon and a slower sky until the first right pop; skippable, and replayed from How to play
features.results: Great popping! card with stars, best streak, right pops, wiggles and any new stickers
features.hints: A wrong pop shows the question's hint (count on from 7, it begins with c); Hint in the pause menu shows it any time

long-way-home.title: The Long Way Home
howto: Pick Cadet (ages 5–7), Pilot (7–9) or Master (9–11), then a leg: Arithmetic, Ballast Trim, Instrument Check, Signal Repair, Scrambled Beacon or the Long Haul.
Read the question on the paper card at the top.
Steer your ship through the ring with the right answer; a wrong ring costs a hull point and shows the answer with a teaching hint.
In word legs, fly through the letters in order, or type the whole word.
Reach the end of the leg before the hull gives out; three hull points left earns three marks.
tips: HINT teaches the step for the ring in front of you: make a ten, count up on a number line, skip-count, or the next sound of the word.
Every three right answers in a row raises your multiplier; every five earns a free kit item.
CLEAR removes all but one wrong ring; DRIFT slows time; PATCH mends one hull point.
Every four answers the questions step up inside your age band.
The end card lists every miss with its answer and hint: read it before the next leg.

controls.keyboard: Mouse or arrows steer; 1, 2, 3 use Drift, Clear, Patch; type letters to spell the whole word; H shows a hint in number legs; M toggles sound; Esc, Space (between rings) or P pauses.
controls.touch: Drag to steer; tap DRIFT, CLEAR, PATCH and HINT under the ship; TYPE WORD opens the keyboard in word legs.

long-way-home.difficulty: Three age bands: Cadet (ages 5–7), Pilot (7–9) and Master (9–11). Each band has its own range of question tiers and every four answers steps up inside it: from adding within 20 up to fractions and percentages, and from short words up to tricky words.

features.age-or-level-bands: Cadet · ages 5–7 / Pilot · 7–9 / Master · 9–11 in the hangar; the tier ramps inside the band
features.hints: HINT in the kit (H, or the arcade Hint) writes a teaching nudge on the question card; a wrong ring shows the answer with its hint
features.grown-up-progress-report: For Grown-ups in the hangar (all time) and on the end card (this leg): skills practised, accuracy, words to practise and what to practise next
features.tutorial: How to Fly coach on the first leg (steer, fly through the right ring, hint and kit); skip it or replay it from the hangar
features.results: End card with marks, log, answers, longest run, accuracy, distance, the missed-question review and the grown-up report

settings.quality: Hangar > Graphics: High / Low (Low renders at 1× pixels without the paper-grain pass; the choice is remembered)

maths-kart.title: Maths Kart GP
howto: Pick your age band, Math or Spelling, and a track, then Play.
Hold accelerate and steer to stay on the road.
Green boost pads put a question at the top and four balloons on the road ahead.
Drive through the balloon with the right answer for a rocket boost; a wrong one spins you out and shows a hint.
In Spelling, drive through the word's letters in order. Finish three laps.
tips: HINT teaches the step for the balloon question: make a ten, count up on a number line, skip-count, or the next sound of the word.
A shield item skips your next question; oil slows the other karts for a few seconds.
Each lap the questions step up inside your age band, so the last lap is the hardest.
A wrong balloon costs speed, not the race: read the hint and nail it next time.
Checkpoints count in order: cut across the grass and the lap will not count.

controls.keyboard: Up or W accelerates, Down or S brakes, Left/Right or A/D steer; H shows a hint; R restarts; Esc returns to the menu; P pauses.
controls.touch: Hold ▲ to accelerate and ▼ to brake, ◀ ▶ steer; HINT sits top left.

maths-kart.difficulty: Three age bands (5–7, 7–9, 9–11). Each band has its own range of question tiers, and every lap steps up inside that range: from adding within 20 up to fractions and percentages, and from short words up to tricky words.

features.age-or-level-bands: Ages 5–7 / 7–9 / 9–11 buttons on the menu; each lap ramps the tier inside the band
features.hints: HINT button (H, or the arcade Hint): a make-a-ten, number-line, skip-count or next-sound nudge for the current balloon question; a wrong balloon also shows one
features.grown-up-progress-report: FOR GROWN-UPS on the menu (all time) and on the Race Complete card (this race): skills practised, accuracy, words to practise and what to practise next
features.tutorial: Four-step coach on the first race (drive, boost pads, answer balloons, items); skip it or replay it from the menu
features.results: Race Complete card: placement, best lap, answer streak, correct / asked and the grown-up report

settings.quality: Menu > GRAPHICS: HIGH / LOW (Low draws at three-quarter resolution for slower devices; the choice is remembered)

math-miner.title: Math Miner
howto: Pick your age band, then Math Mode or Spelling Mode.
Dig down with the arrows (or the dig pad). Every dig costs energy.
Walk into a rock with a sum carved on it and pick the gem with the right answer (in Spelling, tap the letters in order).
Ride the elevator up (E) to sell your ore, then spend it in the shop.
tips: Stuck on a rock? HINT teaches the step: make a ten, count up on a number line, or the next sound in the word.
A wrong answer hardens the rock for two seconds and costs one energy, so read the hint before trying again.
Go up before your energy hits zero: the winch drags you home and the run ends.
Deeper bands pay more for ore (coal, iron, gold, diamond) but ask harder questions.
A Battery Tank gives more energy per descent; the Elevator Shaft starts you deeper.

controls.keyboard: Arrows or WASD move and dig; type an answer and press Enter, or click a gem; E rides the elevator up; P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Dig pad (bottom right) moves and digs; tap a gem to answer; ELEVATOR UP and HINT sit in the top bar.

math-miner.difficulty: Three age bands (5–7, 7–9, 9–11). Each band has its own range of question tiers, and the questions step up inside that range as you dig deeper: from adding within 20 up to fractions and percentages, and from short words up to tricky words.

features.age-or-level-bands: Ages 5–7 / 7–9 / 9–11 buttons on the title; depth ramps the tier inside the band
features.hints: HINT in the puzzle panel and the top bar (and the arcade Hint): a number-line, make-a-ten, skip-count or next-sound nudge for the question in front of you
features.grown-up-progress-report: FOR GROWN-UPS on the title (all time) and on the results card (this descent): skills practised, accuracy, words to practise and what to practise next
features.tutorial: How to Mine coach runs on the first descent (dig, open a rock, answer, ride up); skip it or replay it from the title
features.results: Back on the Surface card: ore sold, rocks solved, misses, deepest point and the grown-up report

word-dungeon.title: Word Dungeon
howto: Pick your age band, then Math or Spelling.
Run right, jump over spikes and stomp slimes from above.
Locked chests and doors ask a question: jump on the floor runes in order to spell the answer.
Take the key from the rune door and walk into the EXIT to go one level deeper.
tips: A wrong rune pops spikes and costs a heart, but the hint that appears teaches the step: read it before you jump again.
Stuck on a lock? The free hint (/ key or the ? button) gives a number-line or next-sound nudge; a hint scroll lights the next rune.
Every fourth depth the Slime King asks three quick questions, so buy a heart in the shop first.
Jump twice for a double jump: you need it for the twin towers.
Coins buy hearts (12) and hint scrolls (6) between depths.

controls.keyboard: Arrows or A/D move; Up, W or Space jumps (twice to double-jump); H uses a hint scroll; / shows a free hint; 1 and 2 pick a mode; B changes the age band; P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: ◀ ▶ move, ▲ jumps, ✦ uses a hint scroll, ? shows a hint; tap a mode card to start and the buttons under the title for band, tutorial and the grown-ups report.

word-dungeon.difficulty: Three age bands (5–7, 7–9, 9–11). Each band has its own range of question tiers, and every two depths the questions step up inside that range: from adding within 20 up to fractions and percentages, and from short words up to tricky words.

features.age-or-level-bands: Ages 5–7 / 7–9 / 9–11 buttons on the title (B on a keyboard); depth ramps the tier inside the band
features.hints: The ? button, the / key or the arcade Hint: a make-a-ten, skip-count or next-sound nudge for the lock you face; a wrong rune also shows one; hint scrolls light the next rune
features.grown-up-progress-report: FOR GROWN-UPS on the title (all time) and on the game-over screen (this run): skills practised, accuracy, words to practise and what to practise next
features.tutorial: Four-step coach on the first run (move and jump, reach the chest, jump the runes, take the key to the exit); skip it or replay it from the title
features.results: Depth-cleared shop screen and the You Fell screen with the depth reached, best depth and this run's accuracy

fishing-for-words.title: Fishing for Words
howto: Pick your age band, then Play: Spelling or Play: Maths.
Tap (or Space) to start the power meter, tap again to cast.
When a fish bites, tap as the gold ring meets the green circle.
Keep the fish only if it is the next letter of the clue word (or weighs the answer to the sum); release the rest.
Meet the day's quota before your casts run out, then spend your coins on better gear.
tips: HINT teaches the next step: the first letter and length of the word, the next sound, or a number-line nudge for the sum.
Keeping a wrong fish muddies the bucket and costs 2 coins; releasing it is free.
A better rod widens the strike window; a better lure brings silver and golden fish.
Golden fish are worth five times as much and go on your trophy shelf.
Every two days the words and sums step up inside your age band.

controls.keyboard: Space or click: charge, cast and strike; K keeps and R releases a hooked fish; H shows a hint; P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap anywhere to charge, cast and strike; KEEP and RELEASE buttons appear when a fish is hooked; HINT sits bottom right.

fishing-for-words.difficulty: Three age bands (5–7, 7–9, 9–11). Each band has its own range of word and sum tiers, and every two days the questions step up inside that range.

features.age-or-level-bands: Ages 5–7 / 7–9 / 9–11 buttons on the title; the day count ramps the tier inside the band
features.hints: HINT button (and H, and the arcade Hint): first letter and length, next-sound and silent-e nudges for words; make-a-ten, number-line and skip-count nudges for sums
features.grown-up-progress-report: FOR GROWN-UPS on the title (all time) and on the Day Complete card (today): skills practised, accuracy, words to practise and what to practise next
features.tutorial: How to Fish coach on the first day (cast, strike, keep or release, use a hint); skip it or replay it from the title
features.results: Day Complete card: earnings, good catches, muddied fish, coin bank, the grown-up report and the gear shop

quiz-tower.title: Quiz Tower Defense
howto: Pick your age band, a mode (Math or Spelling) and a map, then Defend the Castle.
Choose a tower on the right (Arrow, Cannon or Frost) and tap a grass square beside the path.
Press START to send a wave; answer the Command Panel question at the bottom.
A right answer OVERCHARGES every tower; a wrong one makes them sputter and shows a hint.
Survive ten waves to win up to three stars.
tips: HINT (H) teaches the step for the question in front of you: make a ten, count up on a number line, skip-count, or read the sentence with each word in the gap.
When a purple Quiz Golem marches, arm the pedestal (A to D) that matches the right answer to double its loot.
Frost towers slow runners, cannons splash groups at the bends, arrows are cheap and fast.
Tap a tower to upgrade it or sell it for 60% back.
A Focus Token from the armory turns one wrong answer into an overcharge.

controls.keyboard: Mouse: click a tower card, then a grass square; Space starts a wave; 1 to 4 answer the Command Panel; H shows a hint; on the menu Enter starts, 1/2 pick the mode, M the map, B the age band; P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a tower card, then a grass square; tap an answer; HINT sits bottom right. Hold the phone sideways (upright play is optional).

quiz-tower.difficulty: Three age bands (5–7, 7–9, 9–11). Each band has its own range of question tiers, and the questions step up inside that range as the waves go on (every three waves in Math, every two in Spelling); enemies grow tougher each wave.

features.age-or-level-bands: Ages 5–7 / 7–9 / 9–11 buttons on the menu; waves ramp the tier inside the band
features.hints: HINT button in the sidebar (H, or the arcade Hint): a teaching nudge for the current question; a wrong answer also shows one in the Command Panel
features.grown-up-progress-report: FOR GROWN-UPS on the menu (all time) and on the victory or game-over screen (this game): skills practised, accuracy, words to practise and what to practise next
features.tutorial: How to Defend coach on the first game (build, start a wave, answer, golems); skip it or replay it from the menu
features.results: Victory screen with 1 to 3 stars, or Game Over, with waves survived, kills, career record and this game's accuracy

neon-dash.title: Neon Dash
howto: Your runner dashes down a three-lane neon road that keeps speeding up.
Change lanes around orange walls, jump red barriers and pink drones, slide under yellow beams.
Grab coins to build a combo (up to x8) and glowing diamonds for power-ups. One crash ends the run.
tips: Coins in a row build your combo; five seconds without one resets it to x1.
A SHIELD soaks up exactly one hit, so it is safe to take a risky line while it glows.
BOOST makes you untouchable for 3 seconds: ride it straight through the traffic.
Pink drones sweep sideways across the lanes: jump them or pick another lane.

controls.keyboard: ← → or A / D change lanes, ↑, W or Space jumps, ↓ or S slides. P or Esc pauses; Space or Enter restarts after a crash.
controls.touch: Swipe left or right to change lanes, up to jump, down to slide. Tap START to run; the pause button is top right.

neon-dash.difficulty: EASY, NORMAL or HARD on the title sets the start speed, the top speed and how fast the pace climbs (EASY 5 to 20, NORMAL 6 to 28, HARD 8 to 34). Each keeps its own best and top-5 table. The LVL counter ticks up every 20 seconds while the pace keeps rising.

tic-tac-toe.title: Tic Tac Toe — Beat the Bot
howto: You are X. Tap an empty square.
The bot answers with O.
Get three in a row across, down or corner to corner before the bot does.
tips: Take the centre first: it sits on four winning lines.
If the bot takes the centre, answer with a corner, never an edge.
Two open lines at once (a fork) is the only way to beat Hard.
Stuck? Hint shows the square that keeps the most lines open.

controls.keyboard: Tab to a square, Enter to play it. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a square. Undo and Hint sit under the board.

cheats.effect: The bot naps: you move twice, three times
See the square the bot wants next (orange outline)
Wipe the score board back to 0-0-0

tic-tac-toe.difficulty: Easy plays a random square about two times in three; Hard plays perfectly, so a draw is a good result.

features.rules-screen: The intro card on first play (and Exit to title), plus Pause > How to play
features.ai-difficulty: Easy and Hard switch under the board
features.undo: Undo takes back your last move and the bot's reply
features.results: The status line says who won, the winning line pulses, and the score board updates

chili-firm.title: Chili Firm 2: Replanted
howto: Tap an empty pot to plant, tap a growing plant to water it (double speed), and tap a ripe pepper to harvest. Swipe across a row to do the whole row.
The big button always does the next useful thing: HARVEST, PLANT ALL, WATER ALL or SELL ALL.
Spend your cash on seeds, crew, upgrades, land and new businesses. Your crew keeps the farm earning while you are away.
tips: Walk-in buyers pay 1.3 to 1.7x market price, so keep a little stock on the shelf for them.
Water right after planting: watered plants grow twice as fast.
Ripe peppers left too long wilt and give half the yield.
Hire a Farmhand early: the crew plants and harvests for you, even while you are away.
The quest chip under the money always shows your next goal and its reward.
Too loud? The gear button has separate Music and Effects volume sliders.

controls.keyboard: Click pots or drag across a row. 1 to 9 pick a strain, Space presses the big button, ← → change rooms, Esc closes a panel, P pauses.
controls.touch: Tap pots or swipe across a row; the big button and the dock sit at the bottom. Pause is the fourth round button at the top.

cheats.effect: Every growing plant ripens right now
Every chili strain unlocked (this session only)

chili-firm.difficulty: No difficulty modes: it is an idle farm that paces itself. Costs and prices climb with each strain, room and business, the story missions set the next goal, and the 1x / 2x / 4x button sets the pace.

features.offline-earnings: WELCOME BACK card with the cash your crew made while you were away, and a COLLECT button
features.upgrade-tree: Upgrades and R&D in the lab, Crew hiring and training, new rooms of land, and four Empire businesses (jerky, streetwear, chili-salt mine, TV network)
features.big-number-format: Money reads $12.5K, $3.40M and $1.20B in the HUD and panels
features.prestige-or-next-goal: The quest chip always shows the next story mission and its reward; finishing the story unlocks the Legacy bonus (+10% prices, +15% yield)
features.results: Level-up, trophy, new-business and WELCOME BACK celebration cards; Trophies > Ledger keeps the farm's totals
features.tutorial: First play: Tito coaches plant, water, harvest and sell, each after you do the last one. How to play > Replay tutorial runs the walkthrough again on your current farm
features.hints: Hint in the pause menu names the most useful move right now (harvest, storage full, empty pots, thirsty plants, stock to sell) or the next goal
features.sound: Recorded music (a laid-back theme, and a faster rush track that crossfades in when the shop is busy), Tito Scorch's voice lines at key moments (at most one every 25 s, always shown in his speech bubble too) and recorded water, pluck, register and door-bell effects. Settings (gear) has Beat and Sound effects on/off plus separate Music and Effects volume sliders, saved on this device

rap-academy.title: Rap Academy
howto: Pick your level on the home page: Rookie, Pro or Legend.
Training: read a short lesson, then answer its quiz.
Arcade: mic games listen and score your timing on the beat; Bar Builder, Syllable Counter, Faith Bars and Cypher Battle work without a mic.
Every lesson and game earns XP towards your rank; the Practice next card shows where to go after each game.
tips: 💡 Hint teaches the idea on screen: it points back to the right paragraph of the lesson, the rhyme sound to match, or how to count the beats.
Land your stressed syllables on the snare, beats 2 and 4.
Triplets are three even syllables per beat: 'ba-na-na, ba-na-na'.
Breathe at the end of a line, on beat 4, never in the middle of a word.
The grown-ups report on the home page shows quiz accuracy by topic and what to practise next.

controls.keyboard: Tab to any button and press Enter; the mic games listen to your voice; P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap lessons, answers and games; the mic games listen to your voice; 💡 Hint sits bottom left.

rap-academy.difficulty: Three level bands (Rookie, Pro, Legend). The band sets the lessons recommended next (1–6, 7–11, 12–16) and where the games start: Pocket Check's tempo and grid, Breath Control's bar count, Triplet Trainer's BPM, Rhyme or Reason's answer time and the marked Bar Builder tier.

features.age-or-level-bands: Your level card on the home page: Rookie / Pro / Legend
features.hints: 💡 Hint button (and the arcade Hint): lesson-quiz paragraph pointers with one option ruled out, rhyme-sound nudges, syllable-counting and timing technique for the game on screen
features.grown-up-progress-report: For grown-ups on the home page: level, lessons finished, quiz accuracy by topic, games practised and what to practise next
features.tutorial: Four-step tour on the first visit (pick a level, open Training, answer a quiz question, visit the Arcade); skip it or replay it with Take the tour
features.results: Each game ends on a results screen with score and coaching; each lesson quiz ends with a score card and next-lesson button
